intent: Narrow sensor spread further to ±0.035 m to reduce noise and improve control stability, keep sensor size at 0.016 m for robust detection, and maintain stable geometry. Expect improved line detection consistency and fewer line loss events, especially on the s-bend track. Request integrator to increase ki to 1.2 for enhanced integral correction and reduce base_speed to 1.0 to balance control and progress, reducing overshoot and off-track risk.
rationale: The integrator feedback and race data show that narrowing the sensor spread to ±0.04 m and keeping the sensor size at 0.016 m reduces sensor noise and improves control stability, especially on complex tracks like the s-bend. However, the robot still experiences line loss and off-track failures, indicating room for further improvement. The integrator recommends narrowing the sensor spread further to ±0.035 m to reduce noise and improve control stability, increasing the integral gain ki to 1.2 to enhance integral correction and reduce steady-state error, and lowering the base speed to 1.0 to balance control and progress, reducing overshoot and off-track risk. I accept these recommendations and propose adjusting the sensor positions to ±0.035 m spread, keeping sensor size at 0.016 m, and maintaining other geometry parameters unchanged to preserve stability and sensing robustness. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events, improve completion and accuracy on complex tracks, and provide a better platform for the integrator to tune the controller effectively.
